body:
## Confirmed card count

Norbert decided on 27 October 2026 that Dreamrules uses **six Shai-Hulud cards**. This decision was made while preparing the GF9 2019 Advanced to Dreamrules guide. The count no longer needs confirmation.

## Remaining council question

How are all six Shai-Hulud cards distributed during the prepared Spice-deck setup?

Quickstart v0.8 lists six cards, but its setup adds two worms and then “the remaining three,” accounting for only five. Provide a corrected step-by-step recipe that accounts for all six, including the protected opening draws and first-turn handling.

The number of draw and discard piles is a separate question in #1837. Norbert's count decision does not resolve that question or choose a shuffle recipe.

## Sources

- Norbert's decision in the GF9 Advanced to Dreamrules authoring conversation, 27 October 2026.
- Dreamrules Quickstart Guide v0.8, Spice Deck and Step-by-Step Setup.
- [Production Spice deck](https://dune.zone/assets/deck/dreamrules-spice-deck), which contains six Shai-Hulud cards.

Part of #1831. Keep this issue open until the preparation procedure is confirmed.

comments.body:
Confirmed by Norbert on 27 October 2026 while preparing the GF9 2019 Advanced to Dreamrules guide:

> I'll say it's 6 shai-hulud cards, mark that as a decission, in the issue as well

Use **six Shai-Hulud cards**. The card count is settled by this decision.

The setup recipe still needs to account for all six cards. Quickstart v0.8 adds two worms and later “the remaining three,” which accounts for only five. This decision settles the count, but does not specify the corrected shuffle recipe. Keep this issue open for that procedure. The separate draw-pile question remains #1837.

title: Dreamrules ruling: How are six Shai-Hulud cards distributed during setup?
